allocator_review.reason: Allocator counters are a separate observation and are not an adoption gate or timing claim.

decision_review.reason: Primary paired native p50 gate fails both median ratio <=0.98 and bootstrap CI upper <1.0.

guard_regression_review.basis: All 72 retained child reports and receipts were independently checked for artifact custody, binary identity, raw sample alignment, and semantic vectors; primary guard vectors were checked for every primary native and allocator child.
guard_regression_review.uncertainty: The fixed corpus and retained quality receipts do not establish universal correctness or runtime route selection; the timed harness records runtime_route_observed=false.

host_activity_limitation: One read-only experiment.load_plan descriptor/hash validation overlapped the live capture before the parent hold notice. It launched no workload, but may have consumed host CPU or I/O. The host was shared and not exclusive; no timing rerun was performed.

protocol_replay.schedule: native then allocator; fixed alternating AB/BA by (block + case_index) % 2

reduction_crosscheck.pooling: none; each ratio uses one child aggregate statistic and pairs are summarized by median

replayed_results.raw_quantiles: sorted elapsed_ns.samples; floored midpoint p50 and nearest-rank p95/p99

rss_review.allocator_region_peak_note: The allocator region_peak_live_bytes ratio is below one while process-lifetime RSS is higher, so the two observations do not support a causal memory conclusion.
rss_review.claim_restriction: RSS is retained as a descriptive metric; this review makes no causal heap or adoption claim.
rss_review.measurement_scope: GNU /usr/bin/time %M process-lifetime high-water peak RSS, reported in KiB; it is not an operation heap measurement.
rss_review.residency_caveat: The roughly 147 MB candidate cross-format peaks versus roughly 24–30 MB baseline peaks are consistent with executable residency or historical 0888 artifact-residency effects; the capture cannot attribute the difference to candidate heap use.

scope.description: Independent retained-capture replay of raw reports, child receipts, pair ratios, bootstrap medians, metric flags, allocator vectors, failed-call vectors, and RSS summaries; no workload, build, helper, or source action was launched.

uncertainty: The capture is a warm-cache CPU-affined shared-host trial and does not establish universal or exclusive-host performance behavior.
RSS is process-lifetime residency evidence without causal heap attribution; the historical 0888 artifact-residency caveat remains applicable.
The primary gate rejection is descriptive for this fixed 72-child population; no recapture or replacement population was introduced.
